title: Kohaku : privacy for everyone, by default
description:
We will explain and demonstrate how lightclients reduce the trust surface inside a wallet. We will explain and show how embedding the privacy protocols inside a wallet can bring significant privacy gains without requiring expertise from the users. 

We expect to be able to showcase most of the important features (Tornado Cash, Railgun, Privacy pool, Lightclient, Post quantum accounts and hardware wallet security clear signing done correctly). And some less visual improvement (eg. fetching prices and logos in a decentralised way so you don't leak the token that you are touching to third parties)
